subject: Surge containment & SLA restoration sprint — GreenShore service impact
messages:
From: Sara Jennings <sjennings@greenshore.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: GreenShore Ops <ops@greenshore.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:12:43 -0700
Subject: High latency & 5xx spike during peak — urgent readout request

Hi Neha,

Wanted to flag an incident we experienced yesterday (2027-04-26) between 16:45-17:30 PDT during our evening peak. Our telemetry shows a sustained latency increase (p50 ~2.4s -> 4.9s, p95 spiking to 12s) and a brief 5xx rate bump to ~6% for user-facing inference calls. This impacted checkout flows for about 18 minutes; our monitoring automated alerts hit our on-call and we had to rollback a client-side retry change to hold traffic steady.

Can your team provide an executive-level readout and an initial RCA? Two specific asks from my side:
- Confirmation on whether this qualifies for SLA credits and what the process/timeline looks like.
- Immediate mitigation and timeline to prevent recurrence during next week's marketing promotion window (expected +40% traffic).

We're escalating internally and will need a short exec readout for our VP of Product this afternoon.

Thank you,
Sara Jennings
Director, Platform Reliability
GreenShore

[Attachment: customer-incident-screenshots.zip]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jennings <sjennings@greenshore.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:28:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: High latency & 5xx spike during peak — urgent readout request

Sara — thanks for the quick heads up and the screenshots. I'm sorry for the disruption. We're treating this as P1 for GreenShore. Immediate notes:

- I've asked the infra team (Marcus, Connor) to hold a containment run now and to capture server-side traces and rollout history.
- Karthik is owning the initial RCA and will share a technical summary within 90 minutes.
- We'll produce an exec readout slide (1 page) and an RCA draft by EOB today, with a target plan for mitigations by Friday.

For the SLA credit process: we will confirm qualification once we have final impact windows and root cause documented; I'll loop in our billing/finance partner in the follow-up if it's confirmed.

Quick ask: can you confirm whether any retries were added client-side at the time (we saw a client note about a rollback) and whether that rollback coincided with the observed p95 spike? That helps isolate retry amplification.

I'll be in touch ASAP.

— Neha Kapoor
Head of Customer Reliability 
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: incident-acknowledgement.pdf]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Jennings <sjennings@greenshore.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 10:44:55 -07:00
Subject: Initial RCA summary (GreenShore peak spike 2027-04-26)

Neha / team / Sara — quick technical summary based on traces and serving logs:

Timeline & observables:
- 16:43 PDT: GreenShore traffic ramp begins (expected +32% vs baseline).
- 16:47–17:05 PDT: p95 latency increased sharply; error rate rose to ~6%.
- 17:06 PDT: traffic auto-balanced across additional nodes; error rate subsided.

Root causes (combined):
1) Cache warmup storm: A recent model-sync (2027-04-26 12:10) invalidated several shard-level prefix caches. With the traffic ramp, we saw a large number of first-request KV cache misses causing sudden CPU/GPU scheduling pressure.
2) Autoscale threshold tuning: the HPA policy for the pool serving GreenShore is configured with a 40s cooldown and conservative CPU trigger; the scaling reaction lag coincided with the cache-miss amplification window.
3) Retry amplification: external client rollback changed retry behavior mid-window; our traces show client retries increasing in-flight load during the warmup period (amplified 1.8x).

Mitigations taken during incident:
- We increased burst capacity on the Dedicated pool and temporarily relaxed the autoscale cool-down (Marcus).
- Applied a targeted prefix-cache pre-warm for the most common customer prefixes (Karthik).

Next immediate actions (90m):
- Apply improved autoscale policy with predictive headroom for scheduled promotions (Marcus).
- Add a fast pre-warm job triggered whenever model-sync completes (Karthik).
- Add a short-lived client-side guidance note recommending exponential backoff during known cold starts (Neha to coordinate with Sara).

I'll push a draft postmortem to the shared drive and link the action tracker. Attaching initial notes.

— Karthik
Principal Software Engineer, Serving Runtime

[Attachment: rca-initial-notes.txt]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Jennings <sjennings@greenshore.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 12:22:09 -07:00
Subject: Containment -> sprint plan & owners (GreenShore impact)

Team — operational plan I'm proposing (targets, owners, due dates):

1) Short-term (today -> Fri 2027-04-30):
- Autoscale policy change: lower cooldown to 10s; add target headroom 30% for scheduled promos. Owner: Marcus. Due: 2027-04-29 EOD.
- Pre-warm job: one-off pre-warm on model-sync and a follow-up periodic pre-warm during peak. Owner: Karthik. Due: 2027-04-30 midday.
- Client guidance note for temporary backoff: draft and distribute. Owner: Neha (coordinate with Sara). Due: 2027-04-28 noon.
- Add quick-fallback model variant with lighter memory footprint to reduce cold-start cost. Owner: Connor. Due: 2027-05-03.

2) Mid-term (May):
- Improve KV cache replication strategy to reduce shard invalidation blast radius. Owner: Grace. Due: 2027-05-17.
- Add automated integration test that simulates cache warmup under ramp. Owner: Karthik. Due: 2027-05-14.

3) Customer comms:
- Exec readout slide + credit eligibility confirmation. Owner: Neha. Due: 2027-04-27 17:00 (today).
- Postmortem & action tracker (public draft): Owner: Marcus + Karthik. Due: 2027-04-29.

I've attached the sprint backlog (CSV) with task IDs so we can convert to Jira tickets. I'll start the autoscale change behind a canary. If anyone objects to the owners/dates, flag now.

— Marcus
Sr. Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: sprint-backlog.csv]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jennings <sjennings@greenshore.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 16:48:06 -07:00
Subject: RE: High latency & 5xx spike during peak — exec readout & commitments (GreenShore)

Sara — attaching a concise executive readout and our immediate commitments. TL;DR: 18 minutes of customer-facing impact during the 16:47–17:05 PDT window driven by cache warmup + autoscale lag + retry amplification. We are treating this as an operational priority and committing to the sprint below.

Immediate commitments (summary):
- Formal postmortem draft and action tracker by 2027-04-29.
- Autoscale tuning and pre-warm job deployed to canary by 2027-04-29.
- Customer-facing credit eligibility: we will confirm eligibility by 2027-04-29 after final impact verification; if eligible, credit issuance to occur within 10 business days thereafter.

We have attached:
- green_shore_postmortem_draft.pdf (exec summary + timelines)
- sprint-backlog.csv (mapped owners and IDs)
- mitigation-checklist.md (runbook steps for contain -> mitigate -> monitor)

Link to shared draft: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GShore-Postmortems
Jira: GS-3921 (action tracker)

On the credit question: we use the documented SLA impact window + verified error rates to compute credits. We'll confirm final windows by EOD Thursday after the team completes verification of traces and ingress logs.

Thanks for your partnership and patience. We'll run the autoscale change behind a canary and coordinate a short maintenance note if required.

— Neha Kapoor
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: green_shore_postmortem_draft.pdf (PDF)]

From: Sara Jennings <sjennings@greenshore.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: GreenShore Ops <ops@greenshore.com>, VP Product <vp_product@greenshore.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: High latency & 5xx spike during peak — exec readout & commitments (GreenShore)

Neha / team — thank you for the fast and clear response. The exec readout was sufficient for our VP and we appreciate the sprint plan + owners. Two quick items: 1) please confirm once the autoscale canary is complete; 2) we accept the timelines for the postmortem and credit verification.

We'll monitor next week's promo window closely and will reopen the ticket if we see abnormalities. Appreciate the coordinated effort.

— Sara
Director, Platform Reliability, GreenShore
